input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: The renewal mechanic sits in the unnumbered "13. TERM OF AGREEMENT" paragraph (p0078). Renewals are automatic for successive one-year (not multi-year) periods, and either party — including us as Client — may prevent renewal on written notice given only thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current year. That is a 12-month renewal term with a 30-day non-renewal notice window, which meets the preferred position on both material terms (well inside the fallback's 60-day ceiling and far from the 90-day walk-away threshold). Exit is further eased by Section 14 (p0079), under which services continue only until the last day of the month following our written notice of termination. Two sub-elements fall short of the ideal drafting but are not material deviations: there is no Vendor reminder obligation 60 days before renewal, and there is no express cap on renewal-term price increases — § 6 (p0047) only freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds an MFN that rates will not exceed those charged to any other party. We would raise the reminder and a CPI/3% uplift cap as non-blocking asks rather than redline the renewal clause.
